items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Yes, he came in, but I mean I was the main one.

ctx.x: At the beginning? I mean there were some later on that you weren't on.

I did -- the only ones I did not do was when I was sick with a cold, or something. John Hamilton, "Buggs" Johnny Burks, took my place, and another time I didn't show up, Bill Coleman did a date for me. A very fine trumpet player, both these guys, terrific. Bill Coleman and Johnny "Buggs", or John Hamilton, whichever is the preferred, you know?
Now how did the group develop from just a recording unit, to becoming a regular performing group? When did that happen? What brought it about?
